summary: Analyzed 19 findings (10 high severity). Fix routing → Formal setup: 2, RTL: 10, SDC (constraints): 4, Synthesis setup: 1, UPF (power intent): 2. Cross-domain insights: UPF intends clock gating on dma_ctrl and the power report measures high clock power there → intent NOT realized; single RTL fix (wire the enable) closes both.
correlations: UPF intends clock gating on dma_ctrl and the power report measures high clock power there → intent NOT realized; single RTL fix (wire the enable) closes both.

ppa.title: High clock power in dma_ctrl
ppa.detail: Clock power 4.90 mW = 56% of block total (8.70 mW). Likely ungated registers.

fix.rationale: Clock power dominates because registers are not gated. UPF intends clock gating but the enable is not expressed in RTL, so no ICG is inferred. Guard the register with the activity enable.
references: global:Clock power dominated by ungated registers

ppa.title: IP→top clock mismatch (clk_usb vs clk_120m)
ppa.detail: Block clk_usb (10.0ns) not reconciled with top clk_120m (8.33ns).

fix.rationale: Promote usb_ip block clock to the true top clock and re-budget.
fix.snippet:
create_clock -name clk_120m -period 8.33 [get_ports clk_120m]
# map usb_ip onto clk_120m; drop stale clk_usb 10.0ns definition

ppa.title: Missing isolation strategy on PD_DMA outputs
ppa.detail: Switchable-domain outputs cross to always-on domain without isolation.

fix.rationale: Switchable-domain outputs cross to always-on logic without isolation — they float when powered down. Add isolation.
fix.snippet:
set_isolation iso_dma -domain PD_DMA -isolation_power_net VDD_AO -clamp_value 0 -applies_to outputs
set_isolation_control iso_dma -domain PD_DMA -isolation_signal iso_en -isolation_sense high
references: design:Known design intent notes (authoritative for analysis)

ppa.title: Clock-gating intent not realized on dma_ctrl
ppa.detail: UPF intends clock gating; RTL enable not wired (cross-check power report).

fix.rationale: UPF clock-gating intent is correct but unrealized — the fix is in RTL: wire the enable so an ICG is inferred (see dma_ctrl.sv:142).
fix.snippet: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (dma_active) buf_q <= wdata;
references: design:Known design intent notes (authoritative for analysis)
global:Clock power dominated by ungated registers

ppa.title: LEC non-equivalence on dma_ctrl/buf_q[3]
ppa.detail: clock-gating enable added downstream of compare point

fix.rationale: Non-equivalence is caused by an intended clock-gating ECO, not an RTL bug. Model the ICG in the LEC setup so the compare point matches — do NOT edit RTL.
references: global:or model the gating so the compare point matches

ppa.title: LEC non-equivalence on crc_gen/crc_q[7]
ppa.detail: retiming moved register across combinational XOR (phase mismatch)

fix.rationale: Retiming moved a register across combinational logic, so registers no longer map 1:1. Enable sequential analysis and supply the moved-register mapping.
fix.snippet:
set_analysis_mode -sequential
add_mapped_points crc_gen/crc_q_reg  crc_gen/crc_q_retimed
references: design:Known design intent notes (authoritative for analysis)

ppa.title: Setup violation on clk_usb (usb_tx_reg[0] → usb_phy_reg[0])
ppa.detail: clock clk_usb defined at 10.0ns in usb_ip.sdc but top maps port to clk_120m (8.33ns)

fix.rationale: Block-level clock period does not match the real top clock. Promote the IP clock and re-budget I/O delays at top.
fix.snippet:
# reconcile usb_ip clock at top
create_clock -name clk_120m -period 8.33 [get_ports clk_120m]
set_case_analysis / remap: drive usb_ip on clk_120m, not clk_usb
set_input_delay  1.6 -clock clk_120m [get_ports usb_*]
set_output_delay 1.6 -clock clk_120m [get_ports usb_*]
references: design:Known design intent notes (authoritative for analysis)

ppa.title: High utilization / congestion risk in crc_gen

fix.rationale: Block over ~85% utilization risks routing congestion. Large combinational trees (e.g. XOR/adder) should be pipelined or restructured / shared in RTL.
fix.snippet:
// pipeline / restructure the wide combinational tree
// split the XOR tree across a register stage to ease congestion

ppa.title: Missing retention strategy on PD_USB
ppa.detail: State registers have no retention across power-down.

fix.rationale: State registers need to survive power-down — add a retention strategy to PD_USB.
fix.snippet:
set_retention ret_usb -domain PD_USB -retention_power_net VDD_AO
set_retention_control ret_usb -domain PD_USB -save_signal save -restore_signal restore
references: global:Clock power dominated by ungated registers

ppa.title: Setup violation on clk_cfg (cfg_reg_q_reg[3] → status_reg_q_reg[3])
ppa.detail: source register updated once per configuration write (block cfg_ctrl)

fix.rationale: Quasi-static configuration path treated as single-cycle. This is a constraint gap, not a logic bug — add a multicycle path.
fix.snippet:
set_multicycle_path -setup 2 -from [get_pins cfg_reg*/CK] -to [get_pins status_reg*/D]
set_multicycle_path -hold  1 -from [get_pins cfg_reg*/CK] -to [get_pins status_reg*/D]
references: design:Known design intent notes (authoritative for analysis)
global:Clock power dominated by ungated registers

promotion.title: Block clock 'clk_usb' not defined at top (usb_ip)
promotion.detail: 'usb_ip' assumes clk_usb (10.00ns); top has no matching clock — the IP is driven by a different top clock. Map and re-budget.

fix.rationale: Map the IP's clock onto the real top clock net and drop the stale block clock definition; re-budget I/O delays.
fix.snippet:
# usb_ip: replace stale 'clk_usb' with the real top clock
# e.g. usb_ip driven by clk_120m (8.33ns):
set_input_delay  <budget> -clock <top_clk> [get_ports usb_ip_*]
set_output_delay <budget> -clock <top_clk> [get_ports usb_ip_*]

promotion.title: Block false_path not promoted to top (usb_ip)
promotion.detail: Exception defined in usb_ip block SDC is missing at top: `set_false_path -from [get_ports usb_test_mode]`

fix.rationale: Valid block-level timing exception is lost at integration — promote it to the top SDC (re-scoped to top instance path).
fix.snippet:
# promote from usb_ip block SDC to top
set_false_path -from [get_ports usb_test_mode]

promotion.title: Block multicycle path not promoted to top (usb_ip)

promotion.title: Clock period mismatch on clk_dma (dma_ip)
promotion.detail: Block 'dma_ip' constrains clk_dma at 2.00ns but top defines 2.50ns.

fix.rationale: Reconcile the block budget with the true top clock and re-derive I/O delays against it.
fix.snippet:

create_clock -name clk_dma -period 2.50 [get_ports clk_dma]
